title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Thursday, 15 October 2026
description: Apple reportedly turns to Google's Gemini to power Siri as Meta trims its Reality Labs division while AI spending surges, Australia's hospital funding boost continues to flow amid ongoing Commonwealth-state negotiations, Queensland firms up its 2032 Olympic venue plan, and the Gold Coast unlocks land for nearly 19,000 new homes. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
